claims: Obtain repeat arterial blood gas to reassess oxygenation, ventilation, and acid-base status given pH 7.43, pO2 60 mmHg on high oxygen support, pCO2 24 mmHg, and base excess -5.
Assess and manage severe metabolic acidosis with anion gap 22 and bicarbonate 10 mEq/L, including evaluation for causes and consideration of further bicarbonate therapy.
Assess and manage hypoxemia with pO2 60 mmHg on supplemental oxygen, including titration of oxygen support and consideration of escalation if needed.
Assess and manage hypocalcemia with total calcium 7.0 mg/dL and ionized calcium 0.8 mmol/L, including consideration of calcium replacement.
Assess and manage hypophosphatemia with phosphate 1.3 mg/dL, including consideration of phosphate replacement.
Assess and manage hypomagnesemia with magnesium 1.4 mg/dL, including consideration of magnesium replacement.
Assess and manage hypokalemia with potassium 3.2-3.3 mEq/L, including consideration of potassium replacement.
Assess and manage fever with temperature up to 102.5°F, including evaluation for infection and consideration of antipyretic therapy.
Assess and manage anemia with hemoglobin 9.3 g/dL and hematocrit 28.1%, including evaluation for causes and consideration of transfusion if indicated.
Assess and manage thrombocytopenia with platelet count 104 K/uL, including monitoring for bleeding and consideration of causes.
